subject: Critical: temporary P1/P2 response ladder & coverage variance request
messages:
From: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finlytics.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Finlytics Support <ops@finlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Night maintenance causing degraded latency — need temporary P1/P2 ladder

Hi Naomi,

Quick note from tonight's maintenance window: our customers in the West region are seeing sustained 80–120ms extra tail latency for embedding calls and a couple of P1 errors on model streaming. The engineering team has identified a fallback interaction between our edge caching and Redwood's KV cache during the deployment. We're in a semi-degraded state; live traffic is impacted (~4% of calls fail fast).

We need two things from Redwood immediately:
- A temporary escalation ladder that short-circuits to your senior on-call (P1) outside normal hours for the next 72 hours.
- Confirmation that your P2 response window will remain at the contracted 4 hours, but P1 will be tightened to 15 minutes for this incident window.

I've attached an incident snapshot and a short list of failing traces. We are prepared to open a bridge but would prefer Redwood to host and add your on-call.

Can you confirm availability and any formal steps you need (e.g., DocuSign change, SLA exception) to authorize this temporary variance?

Thanks,
Emma Collins
Director, Site Reliability — Finlytics
Attachments: incident_snapshot.json (text), failing_traces.log (text)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night maintenance causing degraded latency — need temporary P1/P2 ladder

Emma —

Thanks for the quick heads-up and the snapshot. We're standing this up now. Proposed immediate plan (short answer: yes, we can implement a 72-hour variance):

1) Temporary escalation ladder (effective immediately):
   - P1: Senior on-call (Ben Carter) -> Pager escalation to Blake-level deputy -> Exec on-call (Grace O'Connor) after 20 minutes.
   - P2: Standard on-call (Karthik Iyer) with 4-hour response SLA preserved.

2) Coverage: Redwood will host the bridge at https://redwood.app/bridges/BR-3312 and add Finlytics ops as participants. Ops will be staffed by our on-call rotation plus a staffed hotseat for the first 8 hours.

3) Authorization & timeline: we'll treat this as an SLA exception for 72 hours starting now (2026-08-28T09:40:00-07:00). Ben, can you sign off to confirm the variance and authorize the staffed hotseat & shortened P1 window? If you prefer DocuSign for records, I can kick that off — linking DL-87421.

Next steps from my side: I'll open the bridge and share the link, populate the proposed_escalation_ladder.pdf, and post the runbook excerpt.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Attachments: proposed_escalation_ladder.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Emma Collins <emma.collins@finlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night maintenance causing degraded latency — need temporary P1/P2 ladder

Naomi / Emma —

I approve the 72-hour SLA variance and the tightened P1 window to 15 minutes for the incident period. We'll provide the staffed hotseat for the next 8 hours and ensure senior-oncall coverage thereafter as per the ladder Naomi outlined.

I've created JIRA SUP-5421 to track follow-up remediation (owner: Platform Reliability). Please use that ticket for post-incident RCA.

Naomi, please proceed with DocuSign logging for DL-87421 so Finlytics has a signed record; I'll countersign.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Global Support — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Collins <emma.collins@finlytics.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: Night maintenance causing degraded latency — need temporary P1/P2 ladder

Emma —

We're on the bridge: https://redwood.app/bridges/BR-3312 (hosted). Quick checklist I posted to the bridge and copying below:

- Confirmed: Hotseat staffed (Ben's team) for 8 hours, starting 09:45 PDT.
- Senior-oncall (Ben) will be primary P1 contact; secondary is Grace O'Connor after 20 minutes.
- P1 triage checklist: 1) Capture failing request/response pair, 2) Force bypass KV cache on a sample host, 3) Roll traffic to fallback edge if KV bypass reduces errors.
- P2 handling: Mitigation window and follow-up ticket SUP-5421 for RCA.
